[vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height="40px"][ultimate_heading main_heading="Know Your Market" main_heading_style="font-weight:bold;" sub_heading_font_size="desktop:18px;" main_heading_margin="margin-bottom:10px;"]Tenants differ by market, so your unit mix should too.[/ultimate_heading][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text]
​

Recreation Areas

In areas like Star Valley and Bear Lake, renters often store boats, RVs, trailers, snowmobiles, and ATVs. Taller, wider bays suit them well.

​

City Markets

Along the Wasatch Front, renters often include apartment residents, small businesses, contractors, and RV or boat owners limited by HOA rules. Small and medium units are common.

​

Snowbirds and Seasonal Residents

Seasonal residents often store an RV, boat, trailer, or vehicle for months at a time, then return each year.

Tenant mix varies by town and site. Check local demand before you finalize your unit mix, and tell us your plans so we can design around them.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="40px"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="about-alt" full_width="stretch_row"][vc_column][vc_empty_space height="40px"][ultimate_heading main_heading="Built for Developers and Investors" main_heading_style="font-weight:bold;" sub_heading_font_size="desktop:18px;" main_heading_margin="margin-bottom:10px;"]Steel buildings suit storage projects that start small and grow.[/ultimate_heading][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text]
​

Build in Phases

Start with the buildings you need now and add more as units fill.

​

Flexible Unit Mix

Clear spans let you divide the space into the unit sizes your market rents.

​

Short Lead Time

Our current turnaround is 8 to 10 weeks.

​

Engineered Plans

Your building is engineered for local codes, with plans prepared for permitting.

Gates, cameras, lighting, and access systems are provided by others.
